nom: Cetaphil Deep Hydration Healthy Glow Daily Cream Fragrance-Free

segments.oily: A few reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin (nose, T-zone) report the cream absorbs without greasiness and even reduces oil production, though one notes it can feel too rich for oily skin on warm days.
segments.dry: Many reviewers with dry, very dry, or severely dry skin (including under tretinoin, retinol, or eczema/psoriasis) report the cream stops flaking, peeling, and tightness and keeps skin hydrated for the full day, though a couple with very dry skin still describe severe dryness, itching, or pilling.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin describe it fixing an oily nose or T-zone alongside a dry jawline or forehead, with one noting the formula can feel slightly too thick for daytime combination skin.
segments.sensitive: Most sensitive-skin reviewers, including those with rosacea, eczema, psoriasis, or propylene-glycol allergy, report no burning, itching, or breakouts and describe it as calming and non-irritating, but a distinct minority with sensitive or reactive skin report burning, redness, or a face that 'appeared burned' within minutes.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s, 60s, and older describe it as light, non-greasy, and helpful for flaking and an aging complexion, framing it as a budget alternative to pricier anti-aging products.

concerns.aging: An older reviewer in her mid-40s credits it with keeping skin looking less aged than pricier serums and treatments; a 69-year-old reviewer likewise reports reduced flaking and a light, non-greasy feel, with no dissent recorded.
concerns.dehydration: The great majority of reviewers, across dry, sensitive, and combination skin, report lasting hydration, softness, and reduced flaking often described as all-day or 'quenched'; a minority instead describe increased dryness, itching, or worsened dry patches after use.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea, eczema, or general sensitivity report redness calming or disappearing within minutes to days of use; conversely several reviewers report the opposite — a face turning extremely red, swollen, or 'burned' shortly after application.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with oily acne-prone skin credits it with helping repair her skin barrier, with no other explicit barrier comments to contrast.
concerns.spots: Reviewers using it alongside acne medication, tretinoin, or tazarotene report it soothes irritation from those treatments without adding breakouts, though one reviewer specifically blames added niacinamide for triggering cystic acne.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone or breakout-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and describe pores as unclogged; a few dissent, describing small pimples, pilling, or cystic breakouts after use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination skin generally report it doesn't leave skin greasy or shiny and can reduce nose oiliness; one reviewer found the texture itself greasy despite the hydrating claim.

aspects.libelle: Jar appears bigger than actual product volume
Lid does not screw on securely

extraits.texte: I saw a dermatologist about two months ago for acne rosacea. She prescribed me azelaic acid for the rosacea and recommended I use cetaphil (or a few other brands) for cleansing and moisturizing my face. I've been using Cetaphil cleanser and it's been fine. I started using this moisturizer since starting the new skin care routine. My face reacted strongly and burned, but since that was a side effect of the prescription I ignored it. In the last week I switched back to my Tula moisturizer and my skin improved. I thought I had just been on the azelaic acid long enough. Tonight I decided to apply the cetaphil moisturizer and within a few minutes my whole face started to burn. You can see in the photo where I didn't apply the moisturizer to my eye area and it's not bright red. Definitely didn't go well with my skin, I just wish I would have realized it sooner.

felt nice at first but then started burning and hurt pretty bad. used this for about 4 days and my skin became extremely irritated and red. my skin stayed irritated for a few days after i stopped using the lotion. it did moisturize alright

As a very, very dry sensitive skin person living in the midwest, you can imagine how dry my skin can get. I have tried so many moisturizers yet only have tried one cleanser - cetaphil. After spending so much money, I decided to go to cetaphil for my moisturizer as well. After cleansing, I applied two layers of the moisturizer while my skin was damp. I must say the difference in my skin was absolutely incredible! My skin felt so soft and plump that this is now my holy grail. I also decided to pair it up with the cetaphil healthy renew face serum and any possible chance of my skin flaking is out the window. These are my favorite products. Although, I must say, I wish there was more product for how much you're paying. I will also add that the product is super thick, so you don't need a lot, but my skin can't ever have enough! 100% recommend giving it a try!

I have sensitive skin and my skin was dry, red and irritated from a few other creams I had tried and within minutes of trying this, the redness disappeared and made my skin look so soft and hydrated. I am so happy to have tried this face cream! I now use this every night and my sensitive skin has completely calmed down and even looks glowing.

extraits.titre: Oily nose and dry forehead: solved at last
extraits.texte: Yes, the packaging does make it look like you're getting much more product than you really are, but honestly the product itself is so good that I can't bring myself to dock a star from the rating. I have combination skin and my forehead gets so dry it flakes and my nose gets very oily. Now I can say neither is an issue anymore. Since I started using this, my forehead is so soft and smooth and my nose actually produces far less oil. It doesn't feel greasy and it soaks in and leaves no residue. I apply it once every two days and it really does what it says it does. I don't usually leave reviews but it's that good. Try it out!

Love this cream! It has a nice consistency and it has no strong scent. I have oily acne prone skin and it didn't break me out or cause me to get oilier. I think it's helping me repair my skin barrier. There's no residue but it leaves you looking glowy

extraits.titre: Another great moisturizer ruined with niacinamide
extraits.texte: I loved this product for a long time until recently when they decided to add niacinamide to it. I know it's the holy grail for some, but it gives me cystic acne. It's frustrating to have yet another favorite of mine ruined by niacinamide.
